actions.defeat: The company cannot continue without its protected companions.
The captives were marched through the northern pass before the company could rescue them.
The Bellwarden's final toll seals the road. The company has run out of time.

say.text: Easy. Living faces—I’d almost forgotten the sight. We kept the lamps dark so the dead on the road would pass us by.
We came from the crossing. What happened here?

A hooded figure commands the dead from the old pass fort. They call him the Tollkeeper. He had the roadside villages emptied. They've already marched one column east; the prisoners still at the fort will be next. Soon. We haven't the strength to fetch them.
Then we’ll bring them here. Can you keep them safe?
We can. I’ll go with you. There are a few here who can take up arms; give us somewhere to muster.
That child by the hearth—those marks on the slate aren’t letters. Who taught you to draw them?

say.speaker: Villager
say.text: Nobody. They appear when I’m trying to remember things.
A little training, then. We haven’t an academy to hand, but this is better than leaving a gift untended. Stay with me; I’ll show you how to keep it from burning your fingers.
The ferryman’s purse will buy a few more hands. Let’s make his coins count.
He asked us to follow the people taken from the bank. This is their road.

say.speaker: Villager
say.text: Help! Help us!

say.speaker: Skeleton guard
say.text: Quiet.

say.speaker: Villager
say.text: Please—before it’s too late!

say.speaker: Skeleton guard
say.text: Silence. The Bell has no use for your tongue.
Keep your heads down. We’re getting you out.

say.speaker: Villager
say.text: Please—don’t let them take us through the pass.
Stay together. We’ll get you somewhere safe.
There’s a village hidden in the western woods. Stay together. We’ll take you there.

say.speaker: Villager
say.text: They took the others down the road. My brother, the children—everyone who could still walk.

say.speaker: Villager
say.text: We heard a bell somewhere ahead of the column. It kept ringing long after midnight.
First we get you somewhere safe.

dialogue.text: A bell, and living prisoners. It sounds like a binding ritual. Get these people to shelter, then we must reach that bell before it claims the others.

alternative.text: I don't like this. Taking people alive, driving them towards that bell... Get these people to shelter. Then we follow. Whatever's waiting down that road, I won't leave the others to it.

say.text: Living soldiers on my road? You’ll pay for every step. Come closer—I’ll take the toll in bones.
I heard something moving in the reeds.
Back onto firm ground. Let it come out where we can see it.
That smell. Something’s wrong here, beyond the bodies. Edrin used to gather his medicines in this mire.
A friend of yours?
An old healer. A better one than most of my tutors. He had a house along this bank. I hope he had the sense to leave.

say.speaker: Villager
say.text: Inside. There’s broth, and room enough if we move the tables.

say.speaker: Villager
say.text: Thank you. The others are still out there. Please don’t leave them to the dead.
Send a runner back to the ferry. Tell them the dead are taking people east. We need reinforcements, and a watch along this road.

say.speaker: Villager
say.text: They’ll have your message. I’ll keep these people safe.
The villagers are safe. We can make for the pass now.

objective.label: Bring the captives safely to the hidden village

dialogue.text: They won’t last long without their master.
Neither will we if we stay here. Keep moving.

alternative.text: Their master is down. Keep moving—we’re running out of time.

objective.label: Lead Nera through the northern pass by the end of turn 30

say.text: Edrin. Oh, my friend. So this is what they made of you.
Oren…
He spent his life keeping people out of graves. Let’s leave him in peace, and see that those villagers get home.
There’s a stoppered bottle in that bag. Balm, by the smell. Keep it close; we may need it before this road is done.

actions.log: The road is clear of enemies

say.speaker: The company
say.text: A deep bell rolls out of the valley. For a moment, the sound seems to come from beneath the ground.

actions.log: The bell sounds in the valley.

dialogue.text: The ritual has started. Hurry! We have to reach the valley before the final toll.

alternative.text: They’ve started. We cannot lose another moment. Hurry!

actions.defeat: The captives were killed before reaching safety.

actions.victory: Mission complete. The company can rest and regroup.
